deal_value.notes: All-stock; 11.0 Rocket shares per Mr. Cooper share, $9.4B equity value at announcement (35% premium to 30-day VWAP). Value rose with Rocket's share price to ~$14.2B at the October 1, 2025 close.

calculable.implied_multiple: ~4.2x Price/FY2024 revenue (equity value basis); ~14.1x P/FY2024 net income
calculable.calculation: $9,400M announced equity value / $2,230M Mr. Cooper FY2024 total revenue = 4.2x; $9,400M / $669M FY2024 net income = 14.1x
inputs: $9.4B all-stock equity value at announcement — https://www.cnbc.com/2025/03/31/mortgage-company-rocket-buying-mr-cooper-in-all-stock-deal-valued-at-9point4-billion.html and https://ir.rocketcompanies.com/news-and-events/press-releases/press-release-details/2025/Mr--Cooper-Americas-Largest-Servicer-Joins-Rocket-the-Nations-Largest-Lender/default.aspx
Mr. Cooper FY2024 revenue $2.23B, net income $669.0M — https://finance.yahoo.com/news/mr-cooper-group-full-2024-143804455.html and https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/coop/revenue/ (from 10-K filings)
calculable.caveats: All-stock consideration, so realized value floated (final ~$14.2B at close). EV/Revenue is not the standard lens for an MSR-heavy mortgage servicer; equity-value multiples (P/Revenue, P/E, P/TBV) are more meaningful. Announcement materials published the 35% VWAP premium and exchange ratio but no valuation multiple.

notes: Both parties public (NYSE: RKT / NASDAQ: COOP), so all inputs are firm from filings. No EV or revenue multiple was stated in the announcement; press coverage emphasized the 35% premium and $500M synergy target instead. Announced March 31, 2025; completed October 1, 2025 at ~$14.2B due to Rocket share appreciation.
